title: An InfoCouncil instance's meeting listing: its default page, the year's meetings (HTML)

landmarks: a select named ddlYear (and ddlCommittee, ddlMonth)
rows <tr class="bpsGridMenuItem"> / bpsGridMenuAltItem with cells bpsGridDate, bpsGridCommittee, bpsGridAgenda, bpsGridAttachments, bpsGridMinutes and, on most instances, bpsGridMinutesAttachments

signals_note: 21 instances on 22 October 2026: 1,347 rows, 4,130 document links, 948 minutes PDFs; every row dated (Dunedin prints 22/10/2026, the rest 22 Oct 2026); Dunedin, Bay of Plenty Regional and Mackenzie print no link ids.
notes:
The committee cell carries the venue after a
: never read, never kept (a body can meet in a person's home). A supplementary agenda is its own row sharing the meeting's number; a row's key is its first document's stem. A document's kind is its cell, its format its extension.
applies_to: the 24 InfoCouncil instances of registers/council_minutes/capture.py INSTANCES, from 22 October 2026
process:
Each grid row a meeting row: date, time, body before the
, every RedirectToDoc link by cell.
gates: Rows read equal the grid's own row count (check.py).
on_fail: set the listing aside whole; hold the instance; publish nothing that check.py holds red

title: A council's minutes as a PDF, linked from an InfoCouncil listing's minutes cell (held, never read)

landmarks: linked from a bpsGridMinutes cell as RedirectToDoc.aspx?URL=Open/<yyyy>/<mm>/<CODE>_<date>_MIN_<n>….PDF

signals_note: Recognised by where it is linked and its first bytes, never by its words: no text is read.
notes: Held whole by sha256. Plan 6.3: no read of attendance or resolutions. Ruling 79: no document reading by a model until both boxes are up. The old estate holds 351 of these (listed hash) on its other box.
applies_to: minutes PDFs of the InfoCouncil instances, from 22 October 2026
process: Land the bytes; record the hash against the listing's link.
gates: The bytes begin %PDF, else set aside.
on_fail: set aside with the reason; the meeting row says failed or set aside
